units.text: The lights above the bed flicker once.
Downstairs a television is switched off and the house goes quiet in a way that feels listened-to.
You think I did something to her.
units.name: DESMOND
paren: lunging a half-step, catching himself on the desk, knocking a mug to the floor where it does not break

units.text: I think you were there at 11:52.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: holding the key behind her back

units.text: I was there because she called me! She called ME. She asked for a ride, and I was forty minutes away, and I told her to wait inside, and she didn't, and I have driven that lane every night since, because if I had been faster--
units.name: DESMOND
paren: pointing at the screen, his voice cracking upward

units.name: PRIYA
paren: frozen, the key slipping in her sweaty fingers

units.text: Nobody asked me the right question.
units.name: DESMOND
paren: sinking onto the chair, hands over his face

units.text: A girl's handwriting on the back: "for Des. don't be late."

units.name: PRIYA
paren: peeling the photo off the board, turning it over, her breath leaving her

units.text: Open the folder, Priya. Please. I never could.
units.name: DESMOND
paren: lifting his head, wet-eyed, looking at the key in her hand

units.name: PRIYA
paren: kneeling at the laptop, sliding the key into a small drive port, her hand shaking

units.text: Then it's hers. And we'll know.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: The thumbnail shows a dark street and a figure in a yellow raincoat looking back over her shoulder.

units.name: PRIYA
paren: her finger over the trackpad, not pressing

units.name: DESMOND
paren: moving to sit beside her on the bed, close, not touching

units.name: PRIYA
paren: pressing play, the sound already rising from the speakers like a held breath

units.text: SLOW PUSH IN on the screen as the rain outside the window finds the same rhythm as the rain in the video, and neither of them blinks.
